subject: Initial discovery recap & action slate for HealthGrid POC
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@healthgrid.com>, Tim Hammond <tim.hammond@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial discovery recap & action slate for HealthGrid POC

Alex / Tim — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations going into the POC. I pulled together a one-page MAP (attached) with owners and milestone dates — please treat as draft.

Key takeaways (from HealthGrid):
- Goal: evaluate a hosted + private deployment hybrid for clinical summarization workflows (throughput target ~12 req/s with 2–4s p95).
- Decision criteria: latency at p95, cost per 1k tokens, SOC 2 audit evidence, ability to run in a VPC/private deployment, and support for streaming responses for UI.
- Stakeholders you flagged: Maria Lopez (CFO) — economic buyer; Alex Chen (InfoSec) — security lead (you mentioned he’ll send the security questionnaire); Tim Hammond — procurement lead.

Proposed MAP highlights (attached: HG_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) POC kickoff — data extraction + test prompts (owner: HealthGrid engineering) — target: 2/29
2) Security review — fill and send questionnaire, schedule follow-up w/ InfoSec (owner: HealthGrid / Redwood Sec Ops) — target: 3/8
3) Performance run & tuning — run load profile, tune batch/caching (owner: Redwood eng + HealthGrid) — target: 3/18
4) Procurement & commercial review — draft SOW + pricing term discussion (owner: HealthGrid procurement + Redwood AE) — target: 3/22
5) Exec decision & rollout plan — sign + schedule Dedicated capacity (owner: Maria Lopez / Redwood Sales) — target: 3/29

Attachments: HG_MAP_v1.xlsx; security_requirements.pdf

Asks for HealthGrid this week:
- Maria / Tim: confirm procurement timeline and any purchase order cadence constraints.
- Alex (or InfoSec): share completed security questionnaire / evidence (SOC 2 report, data retention policy).
- Engineering: provide a sample dataset location or sandbox credentials for POC ingests.

Internal notes to Aditya / Neha (cc’d): I think the big gating items are SOC 2 evidence and the ability to meet 2–4s p95. Aditya — can you confirm which model variants we should reserve for the POC and whether a private VPC deployment will require a different ops runbook? Neha — can you start a short cost estimate for the projected token volumes and a one-pager for Maria (economic buyer).

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial discovery recap & action slate for HealthGrid POC

Thanks Priya — quick internal follow.

+1 on the MAP structure. A few operational clarifications I want captured in the next draft:
- Model variants: recommend reserving an L3 quantized variant for throughput (good latency profile) and an L2 full-precision for fidelity checks during the early tuning window. I can put exact instance sizing in the XLS.
- VPC/private deployment: technically straightforward but requires us to schedule an on-prem connector setup window (we should allow 3 business days for networking + firewall rules). Add owner: Redwood Infra Ops.
- KV cache behavior: we should propose prefix caching for clinical templates to reduce token costs — I'll add an action to the MAP.

Milestone adjustments (suggested):
- Move performance run to 3/20 to allow two tuning iterations after initial ingest (keeps buffer).
- Add an internal pre-security checklist at 3/5 so we can validate the SOC artifacts before Alex’s full review.

I’ll update HG_MAP_v1.xlsx with these notes and a preliminary SKU/cost estimate. Neha — can you draft a short executive note (1 page) that converts the cost estimate into an ROI view Maria will care about (TCO over 12 months vs current pipeline labor)?

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@healthgrid.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Tim Hammond <tim.hammond@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@healthgrid.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial discovery recap & action slate for HealthGrid POC

Priya — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from HealthGrid side: 

- Decision timing: Maria expects an exec decision by end of March if the POC shows acceptable perf + compliance artifacts.
- Economic buyer: Maria Lopez (cc’d) — finance will review the ROI one-pager; please send pricing assumptions and any optional reserved-capacity tiers.
- InfoSec: Alex Chen (not on this thread) will own the security questionnaire — I copied Maria so she can ensure Alex has visibility. We will return the filled questionnaire and an extract of our data retention policy by 3/7.
- Procurement: Tim will own contract cadence; our standard procurement window is 2–3 weeks after receiving an SOW and redlines. Tim — confirm if PO or SOW first.

Decision criteria clarifications:
- Acceptance thresholds: p95 latency <= 4s for the baseline prompts (we will provide the sample prompt set).
- Data handling: PHI considerations — solution must support in-flight encryption and customer-managed keys for any private deployment.
- Audit evidence: we need SOC 2 Type II report and proof of key rotation policies.

We’ll push the sample prompts and an initial dataset pointer by EOD 2/17. Alex Chen will send the security questionnaire back by 3/7 as promised.

Attaching: HealthGrid_Security_Questionnaire_filled.pdf (stub) — this is an initial pass; final will come after Alex Chen’s review.

Appreciate the map — we’ll review and get back with confirmations on owners and dates.

Alex

Alex Jones
Senior Solutions Architect, HealthGrid
alex.jones@healthgrid.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@healthgrid.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@healthgrid.com>, Tim Hammond <tim.hammond@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial discovery recap & action slate for HealthGrid POC — MAP v1.1

Alex / Maria / Tim — thanks for the clarifications and the draft questionnaire. I updated the MAP to reflect the decision criteria and added the extra ops checklist Aditya requested. New attachment: HG_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (summary below).

Mutual Action Plan (excerpt) — HG_MAP_v1.1.xlsx
- 2/22: HealthGrid to provide sample prompt set + dataset pointer (owner: HealthGrid eng)
- 2/24: Redwood to provision POC project + VPC connector scheduling (owner: Redwood Infra Ops)
- 3/5: Redwood internal pre-security checklist complete (owner: Redwood Sec Ops)
- 3/8: HealthGrid to return validated security questionnaire & SOC 2 artifacts (owner: HealthGrid InfoSec)
- 3/20: Performance runs + tuning (owner: Redwood eng & HealthGrid)
- 3/22: Commercial review — draft SOW & pricing (owner: Redwood AE / HealthGrid procurement)
- 3/29: Exec decision window (owner: Maria Lopez / Redwood Sales)

Open asks (action items):
- Maria / Tim: confirm that HealthGrid procurement is OK with the suggested 2–3 week contract cadence and whether you prefer a PO-first flow.
- Alex / InfoSec: confirm the SOC 2 artifacts you will provide and whether you need a non-prod data handling diagram from us.
- HealthGrid eng: share sample prompts + dataset pointer by 2/22.

If these milestones look right I’ll convert HG_MAP_v1.1.xlsx to a shared Drive sheet and add owners with calendar invites for the major checkpoints. Please reply all with any edits; if I don’t hear objections I’ll assume acceptance and proceed to schedule the kickoff for 2/24.

Thanks — Priya
